notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.content:
Update 2.6 
In an effort to increase satisfaction during combat and "mow" through enemies rather than forced to swing weapon 5-7+ times... the following update has been issued. 
(Available)

- Reduced all requirements by 1/4
- Increased all damage on all weapons x3
- lowered health by 1/2 to all level 8 or lower enemies
- Fixed +1 to skills on equipment (bite, rat swarm, vampire gaze,warp, etc.)
- Reduced exploding traps, chests, barrels and vases by 1/2
- Ability to avoid lab/glow beast boss special fire attack
- Reduced un-identified items by 1/2
- Added secret passage #5 (with recycler to convert white items into cash) 
- Fixed add to skill points rather than reset if used a "gain a skill point trading card"

notes.title: 2.5 Update Live!
notes.content:
2.5

- Will no longer save you inside the Wraith's lair or Sewer Special Exit if you exit the game via the menu
- Double-click on Unidentified items to automatically use ID Scrolls
- Removed "Game Not Over" from end game over screen
- Minions have more health (Vit x 8 = MaxHealth)
- Minions have increased resistance to getting hurt (Max damage from any enemy is 15)
- Minions now have a 10% chance of getting Killed (rather than previous 1 in 5 chance)
- Minions get more XP the lower they go past floor 5 ((Floor/5)+1 x XP) 
- Increased pet detection radius a tiny bit
- Sexy Woman is slightly shorter
- Fixed issue with tutorial set to "off" causing intro to play again when re-entering starting area
- Fixed Bug with dragging equipped items from Hotel Vendor's container without purchasing
- Minions will teleport if they get too far away (when not attacking)
- Merchant will only give $2 for unidentified items
- Changed dialog with bartender bloodwine transaction
- Fixed issue When trading with Merchant and YOUR inventory is full (merchant no longer says "I cant buy anymore")

notes.title: Update to Version 1.985
notes.content:
Too many to count but close to 100 updates while in Early Access. Getting ready to release soon.  Its been crazy! Want to thank everyone who contributed with suggestions. Some made it in and others didn't (However that doesn't mean they weren't good ideas... its just tough when its such a big project and only a solo dev) - Several of my initial ideas didn't make it in either. But still very happy with the game and turned out much bigger and better than I ever thought! (too big lol)

If you feel like helping out, please feel free to...
[list]
[*] Wishlist
[*] Give the game a Review
[*] Tell your friends about it
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Version 1.571
notes.content:
1.571A

IMPORTANT:  New Load/Save folder (see instructions below or forum to migrate existing chars)
- Added New Random Sewer Dungeon (Vi Tao Territory)

- Fixed black border around Inventory graphic
- Fixed Traps from not working with only +1 on equipment
- Fixed Key Rebinding

HOW TO MIGRATE EXISTING CHARACTERS

Existing characters are NOT deleted... but the newer versions look for saved characters in your personal Windows folder directory. Follow the directions below to copy your characters to the new Save/Load directory.

STEP 1: Right click on Bloodlust 2: Nemesis in your steam library then "Properties" then "Local Files" then "Browse Local Files"

STEP 2: Double Click on MigrateSaveGames.bat

You should now see your old character name(s) located in the
[b]C:/Users/<YourUserName>/AppData/Local/Dungeon/Saved/SavedGames/ [/b]
folder. (of course your personal Windows Folder may be different than shown above)


If that doesn't work, please try manually copying/pasting files by following steps below....

STEP 1: Right click on Bloodlust 2: Nemesis in your steam library then "Properties" then "Local Files" then "Browse Local Files"

STEP 2: Click on "DUNGEON" folder then "SAVED" folder then Right Click on "SAVEDGAMES" folder and select COPY

STEP 3: Navigate to your Windows Personal Folder. This is usually something like...  
C:/Users/<YourUserName>/AppData/Local/Dungeon/Saved/
*Please note that the above <YourUserName> must be replaced with your actual username (don't guess this, but rather find the folder)

STEP 4: Right Click anywhere on a blank space in this folder and select PASTE

You should now see your old character name(s) located in the C:/Users/<YourUserName>/AppData/Local/Dungeon/Saved/SavedGames/ folder.

MAKE SURE YOU ARE ALWAYS "COPYING" FILES, RATHER THAN "MOVING" SINCE THAT WAY YOU ALWAYS HAVE A BACKUP!

notes.title: Important Info About Next Update
notes.content:
[b]The next update will NOT find your previous existing characters[/b] and it LOAD/SAVE characters from a new directory. (your Windows personal folder) 

[b][i]Your existing characters are not deleted,[/i] [/b]however newer versions will not find previous existing characters without migrating them over to the new LOAD/SAVE directory first.

Once this is live... There will be a thread on the forum on how to copy files from the existing save folder to your windows personal folder usually something like... [b]c:/users/YOURUSERNAME/AppData/Local/Dungeon/Saved/SaveGames/) [/b]

However it could be different on your system so...

If you are currently in a playthrough and would rather not fool around with moving/copying characters save files... you may want to TURN OFF AUTO UPDATES through steam so future updates wont disturb your current playthrough until you are ready to do the migration. (or start a new character)  You can turn off updates by right clicking on Bloodlust: Nemesis in your steam library then "Updates"

The new version contains a new Sewer Random Dungeon... (a few new enemy types and ability to lower the strength of snakes in the sewer) but is not necessary to complete the game.

notes.title: Bloodlust Update to 1.1A
notes.content:
Version 1.1A (Aug 25, 2018) 

- Fixed Issue with Attribute Stats not loading correctly (sometimes) when entering new areas

- Attribute base stats (stats without equipped items) are shown when hovering over stats

- Removed test screenshots from the save/screenshots directory (it wont remove them - only new installs will see a difference)

- Thirst will not go down during dialog conversations

- Pause menu now Pauses game

- Adjustment to Spiritforce Cost on some skills

- Mine Sweeper disarm game now explodes correctly (you can't avoid by closing game quickly)

- Removed some bloom effects on large swords

- Quest item (384BitProcessor) also drops from server 

- Trading Cards now specify how many cards needed to gain perk in lower right corner of card, Example: "Collect 3 cards to gain Skill point"

notes.title: Bloodlust 2: Nemesis has been released into Early Access!
notes.content:
It's been over 3 years in development and today I am happy to announce the newest chapter in the Bloodlust storyline... "Bloodlust 2: Nemesis" is now available for purchase in Early Access with a 15% discount for version 1.0A.

Enjoy!
